== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Bail Organa (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (<code>1250_34</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 35), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-35-Bail_Organa.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-bailorgana-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Bail Organa (Virtual Block 5)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Master List (Light Side)], official text as of 27 April 2013 (Internet Archive). Icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Agenda: rebellion. Adds one battle destiny with Leia. Your [Coruscant] senators and [Coruscant] Political Effects are lost. While at Senate: unique (•) Rebels of ability < 4 are power +2, and, if you just Force drained with a Rebel, may retrieve 1 Force.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L5368</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>7_27</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
